Archivist Galford is an elite human found in the in the last corridor of the Scarlet Bastion in . He guarded an Archive and the Of Love and Family painting. Once Galford was killed, using a book over his desk set the Archive on fire. When Balnazzar slew the members of the Scarlet Crusade within Stratholme and raised them as the Risen, Galford was ultimately transformed as well, becoming known as Instructor Galford.

Arlithrien Lodge is a night elf outpost on the northwestern shore of Amirdrassil, taking the place of the Smoldering Copse from the Emerald Dream. The lodge currently serves as the headquarters of the Sentinel Army. Its name pays homage to Teldrassil's Pools of Arlithrien.
Arlithrien Huntress is a night elf located in Arlithrien Lodge in Amirdrassil.
Aric Stonejack is a hero card from the War of the Elements set.
Army Unto Oneself is an Aldrachi Reaver hero talent for demon hunters. It is an exclusive choice node with Incorruptible Spirit.
Arnott Granwin is a human located in the Road Warrior in Gadgetzan in Tanaris along with Blue and her Warband. He fights his evil version outside the town.
Armorer Goldcrest is a blood elf located at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods. She is the renown quartermaster for the Blood Knights faction, offering rewards in exchange for Brimming Arcana.
Armorer Roseblade is a blood elf who sometimes represents the Blood Knights at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods.

Aryn Lightfeather is a night elf found in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream. In the past, she accompanied her friend, Gracus, to fight against the Emerald Nightmare on an islet that the Zandalari child Rani had dreamed herself onto. Aryn was called by the adventurer to come to say farewell to the dying Gracus and attended his passing.
Arterial Bleed is a Colossus hero talent for warriors. It is an exclusive choice node with One Against Many.

Artistic Aid is a neighborhood endeavor involving a group of blood elf artists. It first became available on 2 March 2026 alongside the full release of . All neighborhoods, both private and public, had this endeavor from 2 March to 6 April 2026.
Ashen Feather is a Fire mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Alexstrasza's Fury.

Authoritative Rebuke is a Lightsmith paladin hero talent. It shares a choice node with Tempered in Battle.
Awakening Spirit is a Brewmaster monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Vital Flame.
Azure Clutchwarden is a blue drakonid who is defending blue dragon eggs from Primalist attack in the Ruby Life Pools.

Baelin Caldoran is a human found in . Four orbs, associated with the quarters of the necropolis can be found by his side: The Military Orb, the Construct Orb, the Arachnid Orb and the Plague Orb. Each orb that is activated increases the damage and health of all creatures in the raid, and provides specific mechanic changes within the associated quarter, but also causes bosses to drop more loot and Splinters of Atiesh. As Scarlet Inquisitor Caldoran, he appears in Scarlet Base Camp in the . In the Scarlet Enclave, he then appears as a boss encounter called Grand Crusader Caldoran.
Balen Starfinder is a void elf located at the Town Center in Founder's Point.
Baleful Grave-Knight's Crucible is the tier 36 death knight set.
Banshee's Mark is a Dark Ranger hunter hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with The Bell Tolls (hunter hero talent).

Barclay Olson is a human found in Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands. He and his brothers had been serving the Syndicate as bandits for years. During the unrest in the Highlands, the new Syndicate leader sent the Olsons on a mission for the Red Dawn, which Barclay attributed to the leader's attempt to get rid of them. They could choose from two assignments: either infiltrate Hammerfall or plant evidence in Witherbark Village and frame the Horde. They chose the latter, but the mission went awry as Barclay's brothers were captured by the Witherbark trolls, while Barclay managed to escape. He approached the Horde at the farm, where he spoke with Geya'rah. He offered to tell the plans of the R
Bartok Steelgrip was a dwarf found at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.
Battle Meditation is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Flowing Spirit.
Bauman is a human found inside the cellar of a house at Brumewood Hollow in Founder's Point along with Klasa and Riev. They appear to have dug up some coffins, and are taking parts of the corpses.
Baxxel Geartooth is a hero card from the War of the Elements set.
Beatrice Ripley is a human hunter located near Lake Sunspring in Nagrand. She used to be a hunter in the Nesingwary Safari, is friends with Gabbo Blinkwink, and made acquaintance with Maurice Guichi.

Commander Beatrix is a human found in . She is helped by a Scarlet Strategist and a Scarlet Tactician. She then appears again in Scarlet Base Camp in the . She can be seen talking with a . In the Scarlet Enclave, she then appears as a boss encounter called High Commander Beatrix.
Beckon is a Devourer demon hunter PvP talent, available at level 20.

Belaria Salonar was a high elf noble and a member of the House of Salonar. Before the Second War, Belaria and her sister came to Windrunner Spire to say farewell to Alleria Windrunner who was leaving Quel'Thalas for the outside world. Sylvanas Windrunner noticed the sisters' exaggerated reaction to the leaving, considering they hadn't seen Alleria in years prior. During the burning of Quel'Thalas, Windrunner Village came under attack from the Old Horde and their Amani troll allies. They slaughtered most of the elves there, including Belaria. After the Horde retreated, Sylvanas arrived and discovered the dead.

Benge was a young orc killed by the hydra Trigore the Lasher in the Wailing Caverns during his om'gora. His body, torn and cold, was found by a party of warriors and brought to Orgrimmar, where his father turned away from his corpse out of grief. His death became the main topic of discussion in a grim meeting by the Horde Council. Seeking to avenge him, his friend Durak hunted down and killed Trigore.

Bertram Barleybeard is a dwarf located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands. He is an Alliance ambassador. Captain Roderick Brewston appointed an adventurer and Faerin Lothar as his deputies, and they handed Bertram Brewston's requests, as he was dealing with missing caravans. The flavor text on the item Skins of Dwarven Stout is probably referring to this Bertram.
Big Brained is an Arcane mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Arcane Tempo.
Billson is a dwarf located at the Town Center in Founder's Point.
Blacktalon Mage is a void elf or nightborne located in the Roasted Ram in Valdrakken during The Thorignir where she opens a portal to Portal to Stormheim.
Blademaster Darza is a human located in the Twilight Crypts. She is the leader of the Twilight's Blade cultists there.
Bladesinger Alyssa is a hero card from the Twilight of the Dragons set.
Bleakheart Tactics is a Hellcaller warlock hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Hatefury Rituals.

Blood Knight Shan was a blood elf located in the elven camp in the Twilight Highlands during the Twilight Ascension. He can be seen speaking with Voidlight Everdawn. Next to them is a void-infused Teely.
Bloodguard Nelric is a blood elf located in Thalassian Pass in Eversong Woods. Some time after Xal'atath's attack on the Isle of Quel'Danas, Knight-Lord Sunguard sent adventurers to check on Nelric.

Bordol Dewgarden is a night elf located at the Gala of Gifts by the Stormwind Gate in Elwynn Forest during Love is in the Air.

Boreus Umberscar is a void elf located in Fathom's Edge in Telogrus Rift. When the Shadowguard attacked, he helped defend the area. During the war on K'aresh, he was also present at the Shadow Point when the void elves assaulted Manaforge Omega on K'aresh. He can be seen wielding ice and fire.

Brelnor Battlebrew is a dwarf located in Dun Morogh during Brewfest.
Brina Bearclaw is a dwarf who serves as the companion vendor for Brewfest for the Alliance. She is located at the camp outside Ironforge in Dun Morogh. Her Horde counterpart is Grimlash Thornclaw.

High Speaker Brinthe is the current leader of the Machine Speakers and their representative in the Council of Dornogal. In the past she held the position of Speaker, overseeing Machine Speakers for millennia. After asking too many questions and speaking up too often, High Speaker Eirich sent her away to Dornogal. Following the nerubian invasion on the Isle of Dorn and the arrival of outlanders on its shores, Brinthe returned to the Ringing Deeps. With the help of foreigners, she eventually deposed Eirich, who made a deal with Xal'atath, and resumed his role.

Broken Armor is a large orc pauldron located on top of an anvil next to Osrok the Immovable in Garadar in Nagrand.
Brog is an orc child located behind Grommash Hold in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.
Bront Axecrusher is an orc located in the Steam Pools in Feralas during Love is in the Air.

Bronze Brannbeard is a dwarf located at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran, as well as at the Infinite Bazaar, during Legion Remix PTR testing. He resembles and has the same on-click quotes as Brann Bronzebeard.
Bronze Clutchwarden is a bronze drakonid who is defending bronze dragon eggs from Primalist attack in the Ruby Life Pools.

Broktar is an orc located in the Common in Razorwind Shores.

Bruart is a drunken dwarf in the Military Ward in Ironforge. After talking to Bruuk Barleybeard, he can be challenged to a fight to get the Rune of Rebuke for paladins or Rune of Frenzied Assault for warriors.
Brother Atticus is a human ghost found in the cemetery of Stromgarde Keep in the . He will give paladins Rune of Piety in exchange for Rosary of the Light.
Brother Luctus is a human found next to Grok'lo Mok'lo at Light's Hope Chapel in the . His duty is to stay and guide the souls of the lost.
Brorg Bitterspite is an orc located in Durotar during Brewfest.

Bronze Timewarden is a bronze dragon located in the Outer Seal in the Vault of the Incarnates. It can be ridden to damage the mobs on the way to Eranog before Raszageth appears and it is forced to retreat.
Bronze Visitor is a sleeping bronze dragon located atop Challenger's Rest in Dornogal.
Brutal Finish is a Slayer hero talent for warriors. It is an exclusive choice node with Culling Cyclone.

Brunelda is an earthen character in "Forget Me Not", a play performed by the theater troupe at the Proscenium on the Isle of Dorn. She was deeply in love with Clodgran, her fused. Overseer Roskarrag didn't approve of their relationship however as it reduced their efficiency in their work and so attempted to erase Brunelda's memories to eliminate the "love virus" and maintain productivity. Brunelda struggled with the loss of her affection and memories though through Clodgran's efforts—showering her with her favorite flowers and ultimately defeating the Overseer—Brunelda regained her memories and reaffirmed her love.

Bullet Hell is a Marksmanship hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Shrapnel Shot.

Buri is a member of the Claws of Vyranoth located in the Emerald Dream, and the first of the Claws of Vyranoth to reconvene with Vyranoth. After Tactical Withdrawal is completed, he and Suzska can be found at the Central Encampment.
Burkhalt is an earthen theater troupe member located in the Proscenium in the Isle of Dorn. He plays General Emmerich in "The Rivals" and Clodgran in "Forget Me Not".

Champion Aelyse is a human located in the Hall of Champions in the Scarlet Halls. Upon her defeat, she begged Arator Windrunner to spare her life, having grown disillusioned with the Crusade, and surrendered her weapon. She can later be found in the chamber of the Sunwell, having abandoned the Scarlets, speaking with Calia Menethil and Mariella Ward, another Scarlet Crusade deserter.

Christine Brownell was a member of Blizzard Entertainment. Brownell originally worked in quality assurance. She applied to be a quest designer for World of Warcraft. As part of the application process, she had to pitch five quests. She instead wrote five entire quest chains. By February 2004, she had been assigned to Team 2's quest team.

Cloud Cover is a Trickster rogue hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with No Scruples.

Consecrator Hennas is a human located at Aderic's Repose in the Ruins of Gilneas. She is the leader of the Scarlet Crusaders at Aderic's Repose, who are trying to purify the remains of those buried there.

Craishae was a legendary lost queen of Arathor. She is the subject of many myths, of which one, The Ballad of Craishae the First Flame, tells of how she became the first person to wield a combination of fire and the Light (something similar to the Sacred Flame) to defeat a curse that threatened Arathor. She subsequently disappeared, but passed down a portion of the so-called "First Flame" to her descendants. Craishae's legend is of great personal significance to one of her descendants, Faerin Lothar, who heard it from Sygfraed Siegepyr as a child.

Crescent Steel is a Sentinel hero talent for hunters. it is an exclusive choice node with Overwatch.
Crimeon Lablade is a human located in Steamwheedle Port in .

Crestor is a human found in Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands. He and his brothers had been serving the Syndicate as bandits for years. During the unrest in the Highlands, the new Syndicate leader sent the Olsons on a mission for the Red Dawn, which Barclay attributed to the leader's attempt to get rid of them. They could choose from two assignments: either infiltrate Hammerfall or plant evidence in Witherbark Village and frame the Horde. They chose the latter, but Crestor didn't like the troll assignment. The mission went awry; the brothers, except Barclay, were captured by the Witherbark trolls, while Barclay managed to escape and negotiate help. Adventurers entered the village and foun

It is also a quest reward from A Collection of Creatures, which provides one of the whelps free while the other must be purchased from the vendor.
Cronym is a human standing next to Caeli and Terra on the second floor of the Photonic Playground in Dalaran. It's unknown if she survived Dalaran's destruction.

Cutty is a human found sneaking by the wall just south of Northshire Valley in . He will give rogues the Rune of Mutilation in exchange for Cutty's Note.
Cyclone's Drift is a Windwalker monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Crashing Fists.

Cyrce is the leader of the Sturmvyn clan of iron vrykul. She and her clan lived in the Storm Peaks, where she was the first vrykul to tame a galeorn, Thrayir, after all else had failed. Following the disappearance of Thorim, and wishing to avoid the Winterskorn War, she guided her clan away and eventually led them to settle in the area they called the Cradle of Hymosul. When the naga attacked following the Sundering, she and her clan fought them but, overwhelmed, she ordered a retreat to the Vault, and commanded her vrykul to tend to the wounded Thrayir. Her current whereabouts are unknown.

Darmak Bloodhowl is an orc warlock in Razor Hill. Warlocks can bring him a Pure Soul Shard and a Tainted Soul Shard to get the Rune of Soul Siphon.

Dazhak is a proto-dragon located in Galakrond's Fall in the Dawn of the Infinite as part of the Blight of Galakrond encounter.

Dee Rufi is a hozen member of Keg Leg's Crew located in Brew Bay in the Arathi Highlands during Plunderstorm.
Dedric Sleetshaper is a dwarf housing decor vendor found in Ironforge.

Demar Brant is a human located in Farholde Keep in the Riverglades. He is the leader of the Brotherhood of the Horse.

Doran Dreambough is a night elf druid located in during Nightmare Incursions.

Dread Admiral Nightsquall is a legendary night elf pirate captain mentioned in the Return of the Nightsquall. He is noted to have sailed to the west to see all there was of the world and take his share. His escapades in the Great Sea included plundering in Pandaria, Zandalar, and Kul Tiras, and he has a hoard of treasure buried in Tel'Abim. After being gone for some time, he was believed to have died until he returned following the re-awakening of the Dragon Isles. Edward Goodwin is a member of Team 5. Goodwin discovered Hearthstone while he was in high school. At this point, he had nearly completed his engineering degree, but realized that Hearthstone had become his main hobby. Goodwin went by the alias "Gallon," and competed as part of French esports team GamersOrigin around the world. He became a professional esports competitor and broadcaster. He later joined Blizzard Entertainment.
